sources.title: [2304.10573] IDQL: Implicit Q-Learning as an Actor-Critic Method with ...
sources.snippet: Effective offline RL methods require properly handling out-of-distribution actions. Implicit Q-learning (IQL) addresses this by training a Q-function using only dataset actions through a modified Bellman backup.
